headline: Inside OpenAI's Civil War: Staffers Fund Rival PAC to Fight Their Own Boss on AI Rules

summary: A group of current and former OpenAI employees are donating to a Super PAC that advocates for stricter AI regulation, directly opposing a pro-industry PAC funded by their own company's president, Greg Brockman.

source_articles.title: OpenAI Staffers Are Funding a Rival Super PAC to Take on Their Boss
source_articles.excerpt: OpenAI employees have donated more than $215,000 to a political effort opposing Leading the Future, a group backed by the company’s president, Greg Brockman.
